observations: Photo 0: close-up of an engine block with intake manifold, alternator, wiring harness, and a seatbelt wrapped around the block; sitting on bare dirty ground.
Photo 1: wider view of the same or a similar engine wrapped partially in plastic, surrounded by other used engines/transmissions and wheel hubs in what looks like a parts yard.
Photo 2: top view of an engine cover plastic shroud with hand-written/molded text 'V6' visible; intake throttle body and wiring visible below; seatbelt again draped over the unit.
No manufacturer badge, engine code plate, or VIN tag is legible in any photo.
No compressor (AC) unit is clearly visible or separately shown in any photo.
No power-on, start-up, or compression-test evidence; engine is static and dirty, sitting on the ground, not on a stand or in a crate.

claims.evidence: No AC compressor unit is visibly attached or separately photographed in any of the 3 photos.

claims.evidence: Wiring harness and sensors are present but their completeness and functionality cannot be confirmed from static photos.

claims.evidence: No engine code, displacement marking, or Toyota badge is legible in any photo to confirm which generation/variant this engine is, so cross-model fitment cannot be checked.

risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for parts only

risks.risk: Exact engine code/displacement unconfirmed, affecting which models it truly fits
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code stamp/plate on the block
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unverified V6 core, not model-specific

risks.proof: A photo showing the compressor mounted and connected, plus any accessory brackets

risks.proof: Any import/teardown documentation or odometer-linked paperwork from donor vehicle

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code/displacement stamp on the block
Video of the engine running or at least turning over with spark/fuel connected
Photo showing the AC compressor mounted and connected to the engine
Close-up of wiring harness connectors showing no corrosion or cuts
Any documentation on mileage or donor vehicle history
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a complete used V6 engine assembly by type, but with no model-confirming plate, no running proof, and no compressor visible, so it must be priced at its worst case as an unverified, untested engine core pending further proof.
